title: A research agenda for making evidence useful, usable and used in policymaking
title_zh: 使证据在政策制定中有用、可用且被使用的研究议程
abstract: Despite growing investments in evidence-based policymaking, a substantial gap remains between the production of policy-relevant research and the use of evidence to impact policy. This Perspective argues that overcoming this production–adoption gap requires reconceptualizing evidence adoption as a series of behavioural and organizational hurdles that determine whether evidence is useful, usable and, ultimately, used. Drawing on a large interdisciplinary literature, we develop a unified framework and highlight key gaps in our understanding of each of these critical stages for bringing evidence to scale. We conclude by outlining a research agenda for advancing our understanding of why a production–adoption gap persists and knowledge of what works to increase evidence adoption—which, together, are essential for ensuring that the evidence-based policymaking movement meets its promise of improving societal outcomes. Bridging the gap between evidence production and policy impact requires understanding how evidence becomes useful, usable and used. Spohn et al. discuss the obstacles and set a research agenda for evidence adoption.
abstract_zh: 尽管在基于证据的政策制定方面的投资日益增长，但研究产出与证据对政策产生实际影响之间仍存在显著差距。本观点文章论证，要跨越这一产出-采用鸿沟，需要将证据的采用重新 conceptualize 为决定证据是否有用、可用以及最终被使用的一系列行为和组织障碍。基于大量跨学科文献，我们构建了一个统一的框架，并重点突出了在将证据推广到更广泛应用过程中，对每个关键阶段的理解存在的关键空白。我们通过概述推进对为什么会持续存在产出-采用鸿沟的理解以及什么有效增加证据采用的知识的研究议程来结束本文。弥合证据产出与政策影响之间的鸿沟，需要了解证据如何变得有用、可用以及被使用。Spohn 等人讨论了障碍并设定了证据采用的研究议程。
